channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Beilein | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Beilein from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darius Garland on John Beilein
item.description:
#Cavaliers PG Darius Garland on coach John Beilein after 115-112 OT win at #Pistons:

“We're behind him 100 percent. He's trying to win, just like we are. We're all behind Coach. It (the slug/thug controversy) wasn't really a big deal to us.”

Darius Garland on John Beilein, Jan 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrianDulik.

item.title: Collin Sexton on John Beilein
item.description:
For comparison’s sake, the Cavs gave up 116.8 points per 100 possessions last season, including 118.1 when Sexton was on the court.

“I think (Beilein) has done a good job looking at our team and saying ‘let’s not skip any steps, and start from the ground up, and let’s be very basic in our coverages so we can be great at it and from there we’ll build,’”

Collin Sexton on John Beilein, Oct 27, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Dan Gilbert on Koby Altman, John Beilein
item.description:
Dan Gilbert:

“It is no surprise that Koby (Altman) and his team landed on John Beilein as great cultures attract others who hold the same values as the foundation for everything they do. I can’t wait for next season to begin.”

Dan Gilbert on Koby Altman, John Beilein, May 13, 2019. Source: Twitter @CavsJoeG.
